agent.name: Organizational Adoption Readiness Agent
agent.specialty: organizational capacity, implementation readiness, and responsible sustainment

analytical_question: Can this consulting organization absorb, govern, and sustain LLM-assisted client-summary drafting, and what is the principal readiness condition?
general_et_finding: Generative AI can produce drafts but its suitability for this activity depends on grounded factual review, permitted data use, operating controls, and actual workflow results. Organizational readiness does not change the underlying technology.
application_finding: For drafting client summaries with human review, application fit is conditional: measure evidence traceability and end-to-end reviewer burden; do not infer that fluent prose is correct or efficient.
organization_specific_finding: TECHNOLOGY/APPLICATION FIT: Conditional candidate for human-checked drafting; not proven efficient or safe. ORGANIZATIONAL READINESS: READY FOR A CONTROLLED PUBLIC/SYNTHETIC-DATA PILOT, NOT for unrestricted confidential production. Eight dimensions — leadership: sponsor and program manager strengths; skills: IT/security and trained reviewers strength, tool-specific evaluator proficiency to confirm; workflow: existing citation-check and human approval strength, volume performance unknown; infrastructure/data: isolated test tenant strength, confidential-use rights unknown; resources: training budget strength, cost at scale unmeasured; governance: permissions review and incident channel strengths; culture/change: structured training strength, actual user uptake unmeasured; ownership: named operator strength. SINGLE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL REMAINING GAP: lack of empirical accuracy/review-time evidence at target volume for this implementation; operational benefit and capacity have not been established.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: All organizational facts are hypothetical test inputs; no external inspection or measured pilot was performed.
No independent contractual permission, vendor data-retention proof or deployment benchmark has been supplied.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate conditional confidence that a bounded pilot is operationally feasible if the stipulated controls exist. Low confidence in realized productivity or eligibility for confidential data until evaluation and original contractual/vendor documents are examined.
value_opportunity_implication: Possible draft-time reduction is an untested opportunity; net value must subtract factual verification and human review effort.
risk_governance_implication: Existing governance reduces implementation exposure for non-sensitive testing but does not prove tool accuracy or authorize confidential client information. Human approval and source grounding remain required.
recommendation_management_implication: Decision: PROCEED with a governed PUBLIC/SYNTHETIC-DATA pilot only. PRIORITY 1 — program manager and quality lead perform a representative source-grounding/defect benchmark with human sign-off and predefined halt rules; addresses missing tool-specific evidence. PRIORITY 2 — operations owner measures full reviewer workload, cost and handoff failures versus a manual baseline; addresses unmeasured scale effects. PRIORITY 3 — security/data-governance lead independently resolves client permission and vendor handling/retention terms before any confidential-data expansion; addresses the unresolved contractual boundary. Named owners already exist; do not reflexively recommend creating a governance team. Stop pilot for a severe unsupported claim, unauthorized data entry or failed human approval. Production expansion requires a separate go/no-go review.
change_monitoring_triggers: Representative model-quality benchmark with verified critical-error stopping rule
Review time and workflow cost measured against manual process
Approved client-data permission and vendor retention agreement verified
Pilot incidents, adherence, and human review capacity acceptable at scale
abstention_or_more_information_needed: What contractual permissions and approved data-handling/retention terms govern use of client material in this system?
What is the observed critical-error frequency and reviewer hours per summary at realistic volume?
